subject: Virtual onsite: aligning parallel tracks + eval sync
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@talently.com>, Thomas Nguyen <thomas.nguyen@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual onsite: aligning parallel tracks + eval sync

Team —

We’ve got Thomas Nguyen’s virtual onsite scheduled for Tue 10 Aug. The candidate has two parallel tracks (Search infra & Inference runtime). To keep the day tight and avoid evaluator overload I propose we run the two tracks in partially overlapping windows with a 20‑minute buffer for context handoff and micro‑breaks.

Attached: Thomas’s resume + a draft panel sequence (onsite-panel-sequence-v1.gdoc). Can folks confirm the following by EOD:
- who will lead the candidate handshake (5m)
- owner for the cross-track handoff (20m) — I suggest Marissa or Mina
- final debrief rubric owner (I can own score aggregation)

Candidate note: Thomas — Sarah shared that your constraints are Pacific morning availability. We’ll keep the day under 5.5 hours with a lunch break. Expect a calendar invite shortly. Thanks for flexibility.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Hiring Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@talently.com>, Thomas Nguyen <thomas.nguyen@gmail.com>

Subject: Re: Virtual onsite: aligning parallel tracks + eval sync

On Sun, Aug 8, 2027 at 9:12 AM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We’ve got Thomas Nguyen’s virtual onsite scheduled for Tue 10 Aug.

Thanks — I can take the handshake and kick things off. I’ll keep it to 5 minutes: quick intros, what to expect, and any logistics (breaks, chat, how we’ll switch tracks). I’ll also volunteer as backup for the handoff window if Mina gets pulled into an urgent post.

I reviewed Thomas’s resume — strong infra background, lived at two early-stage infra startups. Looking forward to a practical design session rather than whiteboard theory.

Marissa
Senior Staff Engineer, Platform
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@talently.com>, Thomas Nguyen <thomas.nguyen@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite: aligning parallel tracks + eval sync

I’ll own the cross-track handoff and the 20‑minute sync. Plan: 5m quick recap of track A, 10m targeted Qs for overlap (cache/kv semantics + system monitoring), 5m conclude and hand to Laura for Track B start. I’ll populate the handoff bullets in the gdoc and add a 3‑question checklist for consistent scoring.

Adding: Thomas — attaching your resume to my calendar invite for the design session.

-Min
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@talently.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite: aligning parallel tracks + eval sync

Thanks team — quick logistics note: I’ll be remote from APAC that day (transit), so I can’t take the 13:30‑14:20 PST slot. If possible, slot me earlier (10:00‑11:00 PST) for the runtime design review.

Also — can we keep the design prompts concrete? I’ll ask Thomas to walk through a past design using metrics (p99 tail latency improvements, batching strategy) and one tradeoff question on quantization/vs-precision. I’ll post my evaluation anchors in the gdoc.

-Rishi
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@talently.com>, Thomas Nguyen <thomas.nguyen@gmail.com>

Subject: Re: Virtual onsite: aligning parallel tracks + eval sync

Updated plan: Rishi — moved your slot to 10:15–11:00 PST for runtime design (calendar updated). Laura, you’ll take the inference runtime coding exercise at 13:00–13:45 PST. Tessa — you’ll cover the culture/behavioral panel at 11:15–12:00 PST. Lunch 12:00–12:30 PST.

I uploaded the latest panel sequence here: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/onsite-schedules#onsite-panel-sequence-v1 (attached copy included in thread). Please add your evaluation anchors by EOD. I’ll own aggregation and the final pass/fail matrix.

Michael

—Thomas
